verdict.rationale: Foreign qualification is a fair question for a business-filing provider like LegalZoom, but nothing in the evidence pack documents LegalZoom filing a foreign qualification when a company registers in an additional state. The documented services are registered-agent changes, annual and initial reports, amendment filings, and a license summary. These are adjacent filings, not foreign qualification.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the provider handles the foreign-qualification filing when the company registers to do business in an additional state
